subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If 15 men can complete a work in 20 days, how many days will 10 men take to complete the same work?
solution: Total work = 15 men * 20 days = 300 man-days. For 10 men, time = 300 / 10 = 30 days. Topic (Time and Work) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
